item.summary: Index provider MarketVector is moving the Virtune Crypto Top 10 Index ETPs, offered in Swedish kronor and euro, from monthly to quarterly rebalancing in February, May, August and November. The next rebalance is in November 2026, with the following rebalance in February 2027. The products' strategy and fees are unchanged, and investors need not take any action.
